raw_response:
I be farmer for South South, and this my rented plot na small one, just 0.26 hectare. I dey plant cassava and small yam, and for this our area, rain plenty so I no need irrigation at all. Fertilizer too expensive and subsidy no dey reach us well, so I go depend on the manure from my small goats and the bush I clear. I go use the cassava cuttings from last season because improved stem hard to find here, and I go do most of the work myself with small help from my sister during planting and weeding.
